basic_info.description: Perched atop Twin Peaks, this stunning 1 BD, 1 BA condo offers breathtaking panoramic views of the City and Bay, complemented by a sleek, modern design. Step inside to an open-concept layout where the kitchen, dining, and living areas flow seamlessly over beautiful wood flooring. The living room, anchored by a cozy fireplace, is the perfect spot to unwind while enjoying spectacular vistas.  The chef's kitchen is a showstopper, featuring a striking blue glass tile backsplash, stainless steel appliances, and dual-tone cabinetry. The spacious bedroom boasts a built-in closet system, custom upgrades and room enough for a home office. The spa-like remodeled bathroom impresses with a double-sink vanity. An in-unit washer and dryer add convenience.  The building offers elevator access and a dedicated 1-car garage parking space with additional storage. Ideally located with easy access to Castro Street's vibrant shops and restaurants, as well as Noe Valley's charming 24th Street Corridor, this condo is the perfect place to live, work, and play.
